A <br> inside a fenced code block stays a real newline, not a split span

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<pre><code>A<br>B</code></pre>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
